name: Wellmanifest SSOT decision DSL
purpose: Interview-driven classification of duplicated trees into propose-only SSOT decisions
divergence_reason: Polish README intro and English marketing tone may differ from the schema purpose; the JSON AST remains canonical.
capability_use_when: you must decide which of several duplicated trees is canonical, and record why
you need a typed project description an agent can consume instead of prose
capability_do_not_use_when: you want the repository crawled or edited - this pack is propose-only and never writes
you only need git state or freshness across a fleet - reach for a repository auditor instead
